name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoded instructions are invalid, so this is mostly bad data rather than working code. The only readable action clears one bit of a byte at a register-relative address before the trace halts.

name: program_blitter_shifted_copy
description: Computes shift counts from a source position, waits for the blitter to become idle, then programs its first-word mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers. It starts a blit and repeats the setup with a second offset.

name: blit_table_driven_rows
description: Looks up a shift and offset from a table indexed by a value, then issues several blitter operations, each after waiting for the blitter to finish. The control word changes with the shift amount, placing a set of rows at a computed screen address.

name: blit_masked_glyph_rows
description: Looks up a table entry from a character value, computes a screen address, and draws several rows with the blitter using first and last word masks. It waits for the blitter between steps, and shift values set the control word.

name: decode_text_layout_commands
description: Reads a byte stream of text and layout codes. A space adds a fixed advance, a carriage return starts a new line, and negative codes read a following byte as a parameter, while other bytes are looked up in a table to move the cursor.

name: advance_cursor_per_character
description: Walks a text string and moves the cursor by a per-character advance taken from a table. A carriage return moves to the next line with a fixed step, and a zero byte ends the string.

name: scan_text_space_control_codes
description: Scans a text string where a space adds a fixed step and a zero byte ends it. The negative codes read a parameter byte before jumping back into the advance logic.

name: read_text_control_parameters
description: Reads text bytes and control codes. One code loads the next byte as a word value, another adds a following byte as an offset, and a space adds a fixed step, while a zero byte ends the routine.

name: accumulate_text_byte_offsets
description: Handles a text stream where a control code adds the next byte to a running total. A space or carriage return adds a fixed step, ordinary characters are looked up in a table, and a zero byte stops the routine.

name: apply_text_control_step_bytes
description: Handles text bytes where one control code adds a following byte to the running total. Ordinary characters are looked up in a table, and a zero byte ends the routine.

name: compute_blitter_bit_shifts
description: Finds the first set bit in each of two six-entry masks, then shifts a register by those positions to produce blitter shift values. The result is written to a blitter control register.

name: copy_rows_after_blitter_idle
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, then runs a counted loop that copies a block row by row between two pointers. Both pointers advance by a row stride on each pass.

name: set_blitter_copy_defaults
description: Writes fixed values to the blitter mask, modulo and copy-mode control registers and clears the shift registers. It takes no computed inputs.

name: start_blitter_destination_write
description: Waits for the blitter, sets full first and last word masks, and selects a destination-only control mode. It then writes the destination pointer and blit size to start the operation.

name: start_blitter_copy_from_source
description: Waits for the blitter, sets the masks and a copy-mode control word, then loads source and destination pointers and a blit size from its arguments to start a copy.

name: blit_tile_into_four_planes
description: Waits for the blitter, then issues a set of blits to one destination address, advancing it by a fixed plane stride on each of four passes. The starting address is derived from the input value shifted left by seven.

name: set_background_colour_register
description: Writes a fixed value to the background colour register and clears a register before returning. The listing shows only these writes, although the facts list more blitter registers that its body does not show.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine routine and then assigns a global variable to itself before returning. It has no other visible effect.

name: build_bitplane_pointer_list
description: Calls several unnamed routines, then splits 32-bit plane addresses into high and low words and writes them into a list at a four-word stride. Each entry adds the same offset to the running address, and a final pair stores the last address.

name: choose_background_colour_value
description: Chooses a colour value through a series of conditional checks and writes it to the background colour register. Unnamed routines are called between the checks, and some conditions decide whether an unnamed routine runs.

name: compute_scroll_nibble_from_delta
description: Subtracts two coordinate values and takes the low four bits of a third value to build a sign-adjusted shift nibble. Magnitudes of 32 or more fall back to one, and the result is inverted and stored into a structure.

name: run_helper_calls_in_loops
description: Calls unnamed routines in nested loops, with a 19-row outer loop and fifteen calls per row when a flag is set. Otherwise it runs two shorter loops that call unnamed routines, then restores a saved value before returning.

name: lookup_nibble_table_value
description: Takes the high nibble of a value, doubles it to form a table offset, and reads a word from a fixed table. It returns that word doubled.

name: compute_screen_row_address
description: Multiplies a masked row value by a row stride of 38 bytes, adds a fixed base offset, and masks the result to a 16-byte boundary. The result is stored in a global variable.

name: blit_column_pair_with_wrap
description: Adds a fixed offset when a flag is set, then calls unnamed routines around a loop of nineteen steps. It issues four blitter steps for two columns and wraps the second column back by a fixed amount when it would pass the plane boundary.

name: blit_column_pair_negative_offset
description: Subtracts a fixed offset when a flag is set, then calls unnamed routines around a loop of nineteen steps. It issues four blitter steps for two columns and wraps the second column back when it would pass the plane boundary.

name: store_doubled_value_and_loop
description: Stores a global value added to itself into a structure field, then calls an unnamed routine fifteen times in a loop.

name: store_offset_sum_and_loop
description: Stores a global value plus 36 plus the same global value into a structure field, then calls an unnamed routine fifteen times in a loop.

name: blit_tile_rows_with_offsets
description: Computes row and column offsets from a column index and a masked row value, then copies three steps of words between two pointers after waiting for the blitter. It runs only when the masked row value is nonzero.

name: initialize_block_state_fields
description: Stores a set of fixed constants and table addresses into a block of memory, including several pointer fields and counters. It then clears a group of words.

name: write_copper_list_two_pointers
description: Splits 32-bit plane addresses into high and low words and writes them into a second copper list at a four-word stride. A fixed offset of 7866 is added when a flag is set, and the final pair is written separately.

name: toggle_buffer_pointer_pair
description: Compares a stored value with a fixed constant and writes one of two pairs of values to a set of globals based on the result. Each call toggles between the two pairs.

name: dispatch_through_jump_table
description: Jumps through an entry of a dispatch table selected by a global value times four. The decompiler could not recover the table, so the actual targets are unknown.

name: dispatch_by_state_index
description: Calls through a dispatch table selected by a global value times four. The decompiler could not recover the table, so the actual targets are unknown.

name: blit_tile_block_with_masks
description: Computes a block size and blitter masks from input coordinates, then programs shift and modulo control values and starts a blit. A second pass handles the remaining rows when the size is not the default.

name: start_blit_with_shifted_width
description: Shifts an input value left by twelve bits into a blitter size word, waits for the blitter, sets masks and a destination pointer, and starts the blit. It does nothing when a flag is zero.

name: dispatch_after_two_helpers
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then jumps through a dispatch table selected by a global value times four. The table could not be recovered, so the targets are unknown.

name: call_helpers_then_dispatch
description: Calls two unnamed routines and then jumps through a dispatch table indexed by a global value times four. The decompiler could not recover the table, so the targets are unknown.

name: copy_sixteen_tiles_into_buffer
description: Copies a grid of sixteen tiles, each 32 bytes, from a table selected by a byte index into a destination buffer. Each source word is written to two destinations 32 bytes apart.

name: write_slot_pattern_by_index
description: Calls unnamed routines for indexes from four down to zero, then writes the same two-word pattern into a series of slots at offsets that depend on the index. It sets the background colour when a flag is set.

name: clear_matching_entries_with_helper
description: Walks a table of 26-byte entries for a count held in a global. For each entry whose active field is set and matches a global value, it calls an unnamed routine and clears the field.

name: process_matching_table_entries
description: Walks a table of 26-byte entries and, for each active entry at a matching level within a range of positions, calls an unnamed routine and clears its active field. Entries outside those ranges are skipped.

name: update_record_screen_position
description: Calls unnamed routines, then computes a screen position for a record from a table lookup and its stored offset, writing the coordinate pair. A negative flag in the record selects an alternative computation.

name: find_free_slot_or_call
description: Scans up to 32 ten-byte entries in a list for one whose field is zero. When no entry is free, it calls an unnamed routine.

name: run_helper_for_active_slots
description: Sets blitter mask and control registers, then walks up to 32 ten-byte entries. For each entry with a nonzero field it calls an unnamed routine and clears the field.

name: blit_clipped_rows_across_wrap
description: Copies two coordinate words into a structure, then computes source and destination addresses for a block that may run past the plane boundary. It splits the block into two blit passes when it runs past 224 rows.

name: reset_slot_table_call_helpers
description: Sets a global to a table base, calls an unnamed routine four times, and then clears three globals.

name: clear_active_flags_in_table
description: Sets a global to the start of a table of 26-byte entries, then clears a 16-bit field in each of thirty-two entries.

name: reset_flag_when_marker_matches
description: Compares a global byte with a fixed marker character and, when it matches, clears the byte and inverts it. Otherwise it leaves the byte unchanged.

name: copy_fixed_table_into_globals
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a constant table into a run of globals, four per step. The copy takes four steps through the table.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: Contains only an infinite loop, so it never returns. The decompiler also removed an unreachable block that followed it.

name: poll_helper_until_value_matches
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly until it returns 252, returning early if a flag is set. The flag is cleared on both paths before the routine returns.

name: initialize_audio_channels
description: Points the four audio channel locations at a shared address, sets each channel's length to one, and enables audio DMA for those four channels.

name: read_raster_line_position
description: Reads the video beam position registers and masks the value to nine bits, returning the current raster line.

name: initialize_interrupt_vectors
description: Fills a block of ten longwords with a fixed value and stores handler addresses in two interrupt vector slots and four table slots. It then writes interrupt and DMA control registers and sets the copper list pointer.

name: run_cia_serial_mode_step
description: Sets the serial-mode bit of a CIA control register, calls an unnamed routine, then clears that bit again and writes a fixed value to the interrupt control register.

name: acknowledge_pending_interrupt_bit
description: Reads the interrupt request register and, when the bit for one source is set, calls unnamed routines to acknowledge it. It clears a value when a result from an unnamed routine reaches 251 or more, then returns the masked status word.

name: handle_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Checks a flag bit, then rotates a byte read from the keyboard serial register. It calls an unnamed routine when the rotated value reaches zero, and then writes a fixed value to the interrupt control register.

name: service_two_interrupt_source_bits
description: Checks two interrupt source bits in a status word. Each set bit calls an unnamed routine, and the second path runs a count-controlled loop of unnamed-routine calls before masking the status word.

name: service_interrupt_status_bits
description: Checks four interrupt status bits in turn. When a bit is set it clears it and calls an unnamed routine, and the routine returns when none of the bits remain set.

name: mask_interrupt_status_word
description: Masks a global status word with a fixed bit pattern, leaving only the bits inside that pattern set.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing anything, so it works as an empty hook for callers.

name: read_joystick_direction_and_fire
description: Decodes the joystick movement register into direction flags and checks the fire button in the parallel port register. It calls unnamed routines depending on the decoded result.

name: match_typed_key_sequence
description: Compares an incoming key character with the next expected character of a stored sequence and advances through it on a match. A letter from a fixed set then sets or toggles several globals, and the routine ends with a bad-data section.

name: apply_key_letter_to_flags
description: When a flag is set, maps a key character to changes of several globals. D inverts and resets values, Y and X invert one value each, U sets one value and V sets another, and other characters are ignored.

name: store_bits_8_11_repeatedly
description: Runs a loop of 10000 passes, storing the counter ANDed with a fixed mask into a global on each pass. The last stored value is the result.

name: store_bits_4_11_repeatedly
description: Runs a loop of 10000 passes, storing the counter ANDed with a fixed mask into a global on each pass. The last stored value is the result.

name: store_nibbles_repeatedly
description: Runs a loop of 10000 passes, storing the counter ANDed with a fixed mask into a global on each pass. The last stored value is the result.

name: store_colour_nibble_repeatedly
description: Runs a loop of 10000 passes, storing the counter ANDed with a fixed mask into a global on each pass. The facts show the target is the background colour register.

name: shift_left_fix_bit_pattern
description: Shifts a global value left by one, then adds one when the top bit and bit one differ. This is a single step of a bit-shift update.

name: advance_cycle_counter_and_seed
description: Advances a counter that cycles between one and five, then replaces a global with that value times 177 modulo 29245. The counter resets to one after reaching five.

name: format_number_as_decimal_digits
description: Converts a number to eight decimal digits by repeated subtraction against a table of powers of ten, writing ASCII characters into a buffer. Leading zeros are replaced with spaces.

name: stub_decimal_power_table_data
description: Holds bad instruction bytes, so the disassembler stopped here. The decimal conversion routine reads this area as a table of 32-bit values, so it is probably that table.

name: reset_display_control_registers
description: Clears the DMA control register, sets the playfield scroll and priority registers, calls an unnamed routine, then re-enables a set of DMA channels. The first value written is the input multiplied by a fixed stride.

name: write_stepped_address_pairs
description: Computes a stride from input nibbles plus a fixed offset, then writes six address pairs at an eight-byte step. Each pair holds the high and low words of a running address, and a pointer value is stored in a structure field.

name: swap_and_clear_buffer_tables
description: Copies a 32-word table to a second location while zeroing the source, then moves a 256-word table the same way. Both sides are cleared by the copy.

name: clear_table_and_reset_counter
description: Zeroes 544 words starting at a fixed table address, then sets a global counter to 30.

name: fill_tables_from_helper_values
description: Fills 32 words of one table with values from an unnamed routine, then fills two 256-entry tables from unnamed routine values in pairs. It sets a global counter to 30 at the end.

name: compute_palette_shade_value
description: Adds the three nibbles of a 12-bit value, offsets the sum by another value, and clamps results above 46 to 47. The result is divided by three and multiplied by 273 to give a grey colour value, then masked with a register.

name: fill_paired_colour_tables
description: Fills 256 table entries from unnamed routine values and writes each value to two tables 512 bytes apart when a flag bit is clear. Otherwise it fills a 32-entry table and a 256-entry table, then decrements a counter.

name: stub_no_op_return
description: Returns immediately without doing anything, so it works as a no-op hook.

name: process_nonzero_table_bytes
description: Walks four bytes of a table from a given offset and calls an unnamed routine for each nonzero byte. It stores the start offset in a global first.

name: scan_records_return_input
description: Scans four records of 148 bytes for a nonzero first field, but returns the input value on every path, so the result does not depend on the scan.

name: advance_four_counters_and_flag
description: While a global flag is set, increments four counters. When the first counter passes 63, it resets all four and clears the active flag.

name: decode_bitmask_byte_stream
description: Reads one byte from a stream and expands its low five bits into five flag words, each set to all ones or zero. A byte with its top bit set makes the output all ones instead.

name: initialize_bitmask_byte_stream
description: Writes an end marker byte at a buffer address, points the stream pointer just past it, resets the read counter, and clears a global flag.

name: start_cia_timer_a
description: Writes the low and high bytes of a 16-bit count to the first CIA's timer A registers. It sets the timer control bits in a global and starts the timer.

name: start_cia_b_timer_a
description: Writes the low and high bytes of a 16-bit count to the second CIA's timer A registers. It sets the timer control bits in a global and starts the timer.

name: emit_sequence_of_stepped_values
description: Reads a start value from a record and calls an unnamed routine for each step of a sequence that moves by two. It increments a global counter on each step, with the number of steps taken from the record.

name: draw_record_with_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter, stores blit control values, then computes a destination address from a record's coordinates and a lookup table. Conditional branches choose between alternate paths before the blit starts.

name: update_palette_entries_and_blit
description: Compares a stored value with a cached one and, when they differ, rewrites byte pairs from a source table and calls unnamed routines. It then programs the blitter control registers and starts a blit.

name: distribute_bytes_across_two_planes
description: Distributes eleven groups of four source bytes across two interleaved positions. Each byte is written to one of four fixed offsets in the destination, two in each plane.

name: start_fixed_size_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle four times, then loads source and destination pointers from its arguments with fixed offsets and starts a blit of a fixed size.

name: clear_and_wait_for_flag
description: Clears a global and busy-waits until it becomes nonzero. The listing shows only this wait, although the facts list many calls and register writes that are missing from the decompiled body.

name: advance_state_with_helper_calls
description: Updates a state global by checking its sign and value, then increments it and calls unnamed routines three times. It returns early when the value is already nonzero and sets a value to 4095 in one branch.

name: clear_block_and_set_defaults
description: Clears 3432 words starting at a fixed address, calls an unnamed routine, then stores default values into globals. The defaults include counters, limits, a value of 500000 and a fixed 32-bit constant.

name: reset_entries_to_all_ones
description: Writes 255 into four globals and sets six 32-bit entries to all ones. It takes no inputs and calls nothing.

name: setup_blit_after_helper_calls
description: Calls three unnamed routines, waits for the blitter, then sets its mask and control values with a pointer and size. It waits for the blitter once more before returning.

name: round_position_to_grid_state
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then branches on a state value. One branch rounds a position to a 16-unit grid and offsets it by eight before clearing a set of globals, and the other copies state values and returns.

name: clear_twenty_globals
description: Sets twenty globals to zero in sequence and returns.

name: set_slot_state_for_conditions
description: Clears four globals, then checks three slots. For each active slot it sets a marker value and two slot values.

name: step_countdown_and_reload_value
description: Calls unnamed routines and resets a set of globals, then counts down a value. When the countdown goes negative, it computes a new value from its sign and a table and shifts it right by one.

name: update_fixed_point_state_value
description: Steps a 32-bit fixed-point value by one unit, then clamps it against fixed limits and adjusts it by fixed amounts depending on sign and range. One path calls an unnamed routine.

name: step_state_by_two_clamped
description: Adds two to a state value, or subtracts two when the value is zero, and clamps it at 150 on one path. It calls an unnamed routine on the other path before returning.

name: step_fixed_point_downward
description: Subtracts a step of 12288 or 24576, chosen by the state, from a fixed-point value. It restores the value when it would pass a limit, and sets the state to 4 at that limit.

name: step_fixed_point_upward
description: Adds a step of 12288 or 24576, chosen by the state, to a fixed-point value. It reverses the step when the upper word would pass a limit of 9, and sets the state to 8 on exit.

name: update_state_by_flag_count
description: Chooses one of several updates from a state value and a flag. One branch sets a value to 255 or minus 10, another counts a small value up to five, and the state is cleared when the flag is zero.

name: compute_clamped_high_word_step
description: Adds 40960 to a fixed-point value and keeps its high word clamped to 15. It then sets a state constant based on whether the state is six or zero, and other states reset it to a fixed value.

name: select_state_from_mask_bits
description: Checks bits 10 to 12 of a global and calls an unnamed routine when they match one of two patterns. It calls unnamed routines again, then sets a state value to 6, 5 or 96 depending on a flag.

name: move_value_toward_target
description: Moves a stored value toward a target in steps no larger than eight, clearing it when the target is out of range. It returns a value taken from two low status bits.

name: update_mode_state_with_clamp
description: Calls unnamed routines, then branches on a state value. When the value is nonzero it calls an unnamed routine and returns, and otherwise it adds 16384 to a value, clamps the high word to plus or minus 15, and adds the result to the state.

name: clamp_high_word_step_three
description: Adds 5462 to a value and clamps its high word to plus three on the positive side and minus fifteen on the negative side. It doubles the result, calls unnamed routines, and clears a flag when a condition holds.

name: clamp_high_word_step_two
description: Adds 3280 to a value and clamps its high word to plus two on the positive side and minus fifteen on the negative side. It doubles the result, calls unnamed routines, and clears a flag when a condition holds.

name: run_helpers_and_clear_flag
description: Calls six unnamed routines in sequence and updates a few globals. When a value is nonnegative it calls another unnamed routine and clears a flag if the flag is set.

name: approach_target_with_halved_step
description: Moves a stored value toward a target. Differences under 22 are applied directly, and larger ones are applied at half size, with sign handling on each path.

name: store_two_parameters_after_helper
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then stores two input values into two globals.

name: store_pair_after_helper_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then stores two input values into two globals.

name: reflect_value_at_lower_bound
description: Subtracts an input from a value and, when the result is negative within a small range, adds back twice the input to reflect it. It then sets a global to one.

name: reflect_value_at_upper_bound
description: Adds an input to a value and, when the result is nonnegative and past a bound, subtracts twice the input to reflect it. It then sets a global to two.

name: bounce_value_at_negative_limit
description: Subtracts an input from a value and, when the result goes below a small negative limit, reflects it by adding the input back. It sets a global to four at the end.

name: bounce_value_at_positive_limit
description: Adds an input to a value and, when the result is nonnegative and passes a limit of eight, subtracts the input back and clamps it at eight. It sets a global to eight at the end.

name: damp_velocity_by_capped_step
description: Chooses a threshold of 12288 or 8192 from a flag and decays a fixed-point value toward zero in steps capped at 15. The sign of the value decides the direction, and unnamed routines run when the value crosses the threshold.

name: decay_value_with_helper_threshold
description: Chooses a threshold of 12288 or 8192 from a flag and decays a fixed-point value toward zero in steps capped at 15. It calls unnamed routines when the value crosses the threshold.

name: nudge_signed_value_toward_zero
description: Moves a signed value toward zero in steps of at most 15. On one branch a bit of the value decides whether the step is applied a second time, and the sign of the value selects the branch.

name: add_clamped_step_to_global
description: Clamps an input value to a range of minus 15 to 15 and adds it to a global variable.

name: check_threshold_and_call_helper
description: When two flags are clear, compares a fixed-point value with a threshold of 12288 or 12287 and calls an unnamed routine when it crosses. Otherwise it clears the value and returns the result as a pair of words.

name: adjust_velocity_toward_target
description: When a state equals one, it takes the difference between two values and adjusts a fixed-point value by up to four steps of 8192. The direction follows the sign of the difference and the value.

name: stub_check_without_effect
description: Compares two values and returns without changing anything, so its only visible effect is the comparison itself.

name: lookup_table_entry_for_value
description: Searches up to 32 word pairs for one whose first word matches a key, then updates a byte in a second table from the matching pair's flag. A special marker value ends the search early.

name: increment_indexed_byte_counter
description: Sets a global to 255, calls an unnamed routine, and increments the byte in a table at the offset given by the global.

name: steer_state_within_band
description: When the distance between two positions is under 305 units, adjusts a state value from its low bits and clamps it against a band offset by 288. Otherwise it falls back to a fixed value.

name: update_distance_limited_state
description: Computes the distance between two positions. When it is under 209 units it moves a value toward a limit of 200 minus a global, and otherwise it recomputes the value from offsets of 128 and 115 and clamps it at zero.

name: follow_table_chain_twice
description: Applies a table lookup to a global value twice in a row. Each step adds the byte at the indexed table position to the value and then subtracts one, and a zero value skips its step.

name: run_entry_list_state_machine
description: Calls unnamed routines and steps a small state counter, then walks a list of entries in steps of ten words while each entry's sign bit is clear, calling an unnamed routine for each. Later branches reset the state when a counter passes set values.

name: select_fixed_point_reset_values
description: When a state is zero and negative, selects one of several reset values for a set of globals based on a counter. The branches write fixed-point constants and return.

name: select_reset_values_with_offset
description: When a state is zero and negative, selects one of several reset values for a set of globals based on a counter. One branch adds a different fixed-point offset before returning.

name: reset_counter_with_fixed_value
description: Sets a state to 172 when it is zero, then sets a fixed-point value and decrements a counter. When the counter reaches one, it sets several globals and returns.

name: set_state_seven_defaults
description: Sets a flag value to 255 when a global is nonzero. If the state is not seven, it sets the state to seven and loads fixed-point defaults.

name: set_fixed_point_negative_default
description: Sets a fixed-point value to one of two negative defaults depending on a flag, and clears a second global.

name: set_fixed_point_minus_six
description: Sets a fixed-point value to minus six whole units and clears a second global.

name: advance_timer_or_set_four
description: When the state is zero and a comparison holds, adds 500000 to a global and increments it. Otherwise the state is set to four.

name: select_state_with_helper_calls
description: Chooses one of several branches from a state value and calls unnamed routines in each branch. Some branches set the state to 7 or 8 or store a clamped value at a fixed offset, while others return directly.

name: walk_linked_index_table
description: Decrements an index and follows a chain of entries in a table while the next value is negative. A marker value of minus two steps the index back, and any other negative value resets it. It returns the address of the final entry.

name: lookup_tile_attribute_nibble
description: Looks up a tile index from a 16-unit grid position using a table, then follows indirect entries while flag bits are set. It extracts a nibble from a second table and adds it to the grid position.

name: lookup_adjacent_tile_word
description: Looks up a tile index from a grid position using a table, then follows neighbouring entries whose top bits are set. It returns the tile word that was chosen.

name: approach_zero_with_unit_floor
description: Moves a stored value toward a target in steps. Differences under 22 are applied directly and larger ones are halved, and a zero stored value is treated as one in the step.

name: step_value_by_input_magnitude
description: Returns when the input is 22 or more. Otherwise it moves a stored value by the input, using a halved step for larger differences and a floor of one for zero values.

name: add_input_to_global
description: Adds a 16-bit input value to a global variable and returns.

name: subtract_input_with_halved_limit
description: Subtracts a value from a global variable, choosing between the input and half of the input depending on a comparison with a second value.

name: subtract_input_from_global
description: Subtracts a 16-bit input value from a global variable and returns.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately, with no body in the decompiled code.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately. The facts list 24 instructions, but the decompiled body is empty, so the bytes may be data.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately, with no body in the decompiled code.

name: invert_input_and_mask_bits
description: Inverts a 16-bit input and keeps only bits two and three of the result.

name: mirror_value_when_flag_set
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then when an input has any of several flag bits set and a second unnamed routine returns nonzero, replaces a global with minus three minus its value.

name: mirror_value_about_three
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then when an input has any of several flag bits set and a second unnamed routine returns nonzero, replaces a global with three minus its value.

name: update_state_from_flag_bits
description: Tests flag bits on a status word. When a combination matches it sets a state to seven, loads a fixed-point value, adds 224 to it and clears the state; otherwise it calls seven unnamed routines and continues a longer update.

name: check_record_mask_match
description: Compares a flag word with a mask pattern and returns one when it matches. It sets a state to ten and sometimes to 68 on a match, and otherwise returns zero.

name: scan_records_counting_matches
description: Scans up to 32 records and counts those whose type byte falls outside a small excluded range. It calls unnamed routines for each active record and several more on the record's fields.

name: scale_record_byte_by_64
description: Returns the byte at offset one of a record multiplied by 64.

name: clear_two_globals_then_stop
description: Clears two globals, then the decoder reaches invalid instruction bytes, so the rest of the routine is bad data.

name: compute_mirrored_sprite_span
description: Optionally mirrors a horizontal position by flipping a bit and subtracting it from 320, and calls an unnamed routine for the mirrored case. It then computes a pixel span from two record bytes multiplied together and stores it.

name: compute_record_span_and_offsets
description: Reads two byte fields from a record, multiplies them into a span, and writes a position offset into a structure. Flag bit eight selects one of two coordinate pairs from the record.

name: find_entries_inside_screen_window
description: Scans a list of entries that ends at a negative marker and collects those whose positions fall inside a window. The window spans 128 below the reference position and 432 or 336 above it, and each match triggers further processing.

name: position_record_from_anchor
description: Subtracts offsets derived from two fields of a source record from the position of a destination record, using 16 as a base offset. It copies a masked value into the destination when a result from an unnamed routine is nonzero and a flag bit is clear.

name: allocate_entry_slot_with_values
description: Scans 32 entries for one whose first byte has its sign bit set. When it finds one it stores three input values into it, clears its fields, copies a table byte selected by an input value, and increments a counter.

name: allocate_entry_slot_with_pointer
description: Scans 32 entries for one whose first byte has its sign bit set, then initializes it from three input values, a table byte and a pointer argument.

name: offset_record_relative_to_source
description: Subtracts offsets derived from two fields of a source record from the position of a destination record. It copies a masked value when a result from an unnamed routine is nonzero and the source's state field is not one.

name: update_entries_by_type_codes
description: Loops over 32 entries and dispatches each nonzero entry by its type word, using ranges of that word to choose between unnamed routines. Several branches also call unnamed routines on the entry's fields.

name: initialize_entry_state_by_flags
description: Chooses default state bytes for an entry from its flag word and adjusts its position by half of a field. It writes a fixed value to one of its words and sets a timer to 60 when a global is zero.

name: set_entry_type_sub_codes
description: Chooses a type word and a sub-code from the entry's flag bits, then writes that sub-code into each of four fields that are already nonzero.

name: set_default_size_from_field
description: Sets a global to 32, then when a field is nonzero sets it to 16 and shifts a second byte left by four. Both branches compute the second value the same way.

name: update_entry_flags_and_timers
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then checks flag bits on an input and on the entry. When the bits match it sets a timer byte to 20 and combines globals, and further branches set a state of 6 or 96 depending on a value.

name: check_entry_proximity_and_trigger
description: Compares an entry's field with a global value and, when it lies within a window, sets a timer byte to 10. It then computes a new position from one and a half times the global minus a field, and otherwise returns unchanged.

name: write_frame_bytes_for_entry
description: For an entry of one kind, clears two table words and writes a set of frame bytes at positions derived from the entry's position. The rest of the routine updates related state and calls unnamed routines.

name: update_frame_table_for_entry
description: Clears two table words for an entry of one kind, writes a set of frame bytes at positions taken from its position, then calls two unnamed routines to update a second table.

name: advance_entry_and_check_range
description: Advances an entry by its speed field, decrementing the speed on odd positions, and calls an unnamed routine to check its range. When the range value reaches 131 or more it clears or updates the linked record.

name: release_entry_when_off_screen
description: Checks whether an entry's linked record is still inside a window of 304 by 208 units around a reference position. If it is not, the entry is cleared, its type is saved to the linked record, and a count is decremented.

name: dispatch_entry_by_type_byte
description: Dispatches on a type byte of an entry. Some codes set a timer or counter, and others call an unnamed routine or set values such as 2000 or 112. Codes outside the handled range leave the entry unchanged.

name: set_entry_byte_after_helper
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then stores the input byte into a fixed byte field of the entry.

name: allocate_entry_with_fields
description: Finds the first empty slot in a list of 32 entries, where an empty entry has a zero first word, and fills it from its inputs. Entries with a type word above 57343 also get extra fields set, and a count is incremented.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately, with no body in the decompiled code.

name: flush_entry_values_to_links
description: Scans 32 entries and, for each nonzero first word, copies that word into a field of a linked record and clears the entry while decrementing a count. It returns the value from the last entry it visited.

name: advance_entry_animation_frame
description: Adds a table-driven offset to an entry's position and decrements its frame counter. The counter is set to minus one when it reaches zero or ten, and a state byte that no longer matches the current entry is cleared.

name: dispatch_entry_handler_by_flags
description: Checks an entry's flag word and, when a set of conditions holds, sets a marker flag. It then calls a handler selected by the low five bits of the flag word through a jump table, which the decompiler could not recover.

name: dispatch_entry_handler_alt
description: Checks an entry's flag word and, when conditions hold, sets a marker flag. It then calls a handler selected by the low five bits of the flag word through a jump table, which the decompiler could not recover.

name: clear_high_bit_toggle_low
description: Clears the top bit of a byte field and then toggles its lowest bit.

name: place_entry_within_tile_bounds
description: Computes a table address from an input index scaled by 128 plus a base offset, then adjusts an entry's coordinates against 16-unit tile bounds.

name: place_entry_and_adjust_offsets
description: Computes an entry's placement relative to a 16-unit tile grid and the input index. It adjusts its coordinates and an offset value when they fall outside tile bounds.

name: return_zero_after_optional_helper
description: Calls an unnamed routine when a global is zero, then returns zero.

name: service_interrupt_request_bits
description: Checks four bits of an interrupt status word in turn. When a bit is set and the matching bit of the interrupt request register is also set, it calls an unnamed routine.

name: write_entry_position_record
description: Decrements a counter in an entry, then writes a position computed from an offset and a base into a record, copies a field into the output, or stores a fixed constant and sets a flag word to one. The entry's field is copied into a second structure.

name: copy_draw_state_into_record
description: Calls unnamed routines and copies a sprite's position and frame globals into a record, clamping a computed difference at zero. When a flag is set it resets the flag and copies two more values and a table constant into the record.
